title: A Machine Learning Predictive Model for Post-Ureteroscopy Urosepsis Needing Intensive Care Unit Admission: A Case-Control YAU Endourology Study from Nine European Centres
summary: A random-forest model used nine-center case-control data to predict ICU-level urosepsis after ureteroscopy, with an internal 70/30 split; it classified 14/17 sepsis cases and 12/15 controls correctly in the test set. The small matched sample and lack of external validation limit generalization.
ai_technology: Random-forest classification predicts post-ureteroscopy urosepsis requiring ICU admission.
organization: Department of Urology, University Hospital Southampton, Southampton SO16 6YD, UK.

evidence.tested: Random forest with 300 trees on clinical/procedural factors, random 70/30 train/test split (seed 1234). Nine European centers supplied 57 ICU-urosepsis cases and 57 controls. Test performance: 82% cases, 80% controls; AUC 0.89; authors call for external validation.
